title: Custom Greetings
description: This Mod Adds Custom Greetings that Sends a Message to a Player Each Time They Join. It's Customisable by going to Config Files.
body:
This Mod Adds **Customisable** Greetings that Serve as Little Information Textboxes meant for Large Modpacks.
These Greetings are **Sent to a Player** upon Joining a Server/World.
This Greeting is Customisable by Editing the **Config File**.

<details>
<summary>In a Modpack</summary>

I am **fine** with this **being used in a modpack** as long as credited. It is recommended to put this mod into a Modpack.

</details>
